branch_purpose: One finite synthetic execution under a hidden-sign, two-action, noisy-sign observation family. Exploration uses an ex-ante fixed full-support action schedule; adjacent three-observation products cancel hidden state and identify six moments only in the nondegenerate regime. Recorded stream totals 60,000 train, 12,000 pre-task validation and 75,360 total unique transitions; each held-out objective uses 16 segments. This does not cover adaptive exploration, model misspecification or physical reset/state access.

assumptions: The hidden-sign family and nondegeneracy conditions hold.
Exploration actions follow the supplied ex-ante fixed full-support schedule.
Reward and conditional expected-regret values are evaluated with privileged source truth.
